war_summary: War 139, day 93, no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map is heavily polarized: many regions are fully owned by one side with near-zero current combat (e.g., Acrithia, Dead Lands, Heartlands for Colonials; Reaching Trail, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse for Wardens), indicating stable rear areas. Active fighting is concentrated in a handful of contested regions: Oarbreaker (37 base events in 24h, ongoing flips at Posterus/Grisly Refuge), Clahstra (14 events, heavy accelerating casualties ~1,700/6h with Warden edge), Mooring County (18 events but quiet in last 6h), Stlican Shelf (17 events, casualties surging from near-zero to ~1,100/6h), Endless Shore (11 events, cooling from a spike), and Olavis Wake/Onyx (high casualty rates, recent activity). Callahan's Passage shows the highest raw casualty rates (~6,200/6h) but no recorded base events. Uncertainty: event feeds show zero events in the last 2h across all regions despite high casualty rates, suggesting either lull or reporting lag; history covers only ~11 hours, so trend durability is unverified; several hot regions' latest events are 10+ hours old.
